## What is the current behavior?
<!-- Please describe the current behavior that you are modifying, or link to a relevant issue. -->
In #22394, a new parameter called `relativeLinkResolution` had been added to `recogize` function, but due to router refactorisation in #25740, it has been wrapped by `recognize` operator, which misses this newly added parameter.
Issue Number: #26983


## What is the new behavior?
The `recognize` operator now includes `relativeLinkResolution` parameter.

# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/angular ### Is this a regression? Unknown ### Description See the README in the repository. In summary, angular/packages/router/src/create_url_tree.ts, function replaceSegment, appears to rely on comparing object references when navigating a router outlet to a new URL, when it should be comparing the actual URLs. The Ionic application in the repository reproduces the failure. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction The problem is reproduced in an Ionic v4 based repository, which is unsupported by either Plunkr or stackblitz. The repository can be found here: https://github.com/TiVoMaker/Angular-Routing-Bug See the README in the repo. ## 🔥 Exception or Error
